PullRequest.Title: test: use a fixture for the Markdown rich editor diagnostics test
PullRequest.Body:
Refs #343832

`Markdown editor pull diagnostics › validates and clears diagnostics with only a custom-editor tab open` keeps failing in the Linux `Remote` integration run. The `No header found: 'missing'` warning is never cleared after the edit, most recently in main CI build 494170. This PR stops the test from racing a file watcher event. The underlying server bug is described below so it can be fixed separately.

## What happens

The test creates its Markdown file with `workspace.fs.writeFile` and opens it in the rich editor right away. The language client forwards file watcher events to the server through a 250 ms debounce (`_fileEventDelayer` in `vscode-languageclient`). Over a remote connection, the watcher event for the new file can reach the server after the test's edit.

In `vscode-markdown-languageserver` 0.5.0, `VsCodeClientWorkspace` handles a `Changed` (or `Created`) event for a cached document by calling `openMarkdownDocumentFromFs`. That re-reads the file and **replaces** the cache entry with a new disk-only document, dropping the in-memory one. Every later diagnostics pull is then computed from the old on-disk text, so the warning keeps coming back until the next edit. Locally, the event arrives before `didOpen` and is ignored, which is why only Remote fails.

## Proof

I couldn't reproduce the remote timing locally, so I drove the server's real `VsCodeClientWorkspace` and `createPullDiagnosticsManager` (upstream `main`) through the sequence directly: open the document with the broken link, apply the fix edit, then deliver a late watched-file event whose file read returns the unsaved disk content.

| Late event | Diagnostics after the edit | Server's text for the open document |
|---|---|---|
| none | `[]` | edited text, version 2 |
| `Created` | `[]` | **on-disk text, version 0** |
| `Changed` | **`No header found: 'missing'`** | **on-disk text, version 0** |
| `Created` + `Changed` | **`No header found: 'missing'`** | **on-disk text, version 0** |

The last two rows match the CI failure exactly. Keeping the existing cache entry and only updating its on-disk document in `openMarkdownDocumentFromFs` makes all four rows clear.

## The change

The test now uses a committed fixture (`test-workspace/markdown-rich-diagnostics.md`) instead of creating the file, so no Markdown file watcher event fires for it during the test. In `finally` it restores the original text before saving, so the fixture stays byte-identical. What the test checks hasn't changed: diagnostics appear and clear with only the custom-editor tab open.

The server bug is real but outside this repo (`vscode-markdown-languageserver`). It only matters when a file changes on disk while it has unsaved edits, so I'm reporting it separately rather than masking it here.

## Validation

- Mechanism reproduced with the harness above. The proposed server fix clears all four cases.
- `tsc -p extensions/markdown-language-features/tsconfig.json --noEmit` and eslint are clean.
- I couldn't run the integration suite locally (this machine can't install main's current dependencies), so PR CI's Linux Electron and Remote runs are the end-to-end check.
